grandparents_cupboard.reason: Onion, mushrooms, carrots, bulgur, tinned chickpeas, stock, spinach and feta are all plain foods with nothing from a jar or packet mix.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a wide lidded pan, a grater and a knife, and the technique is simple frying and simmering.

works.reason: 250g bulgur to 600ml stock with a 12-minute simmer and 5-minute rest should come out tender, and 400g mushrooms, three carrots and a tin of chickpeas make a fair amount for four.

honest_times.reason: Slicing, grating and 9 minutes of frying fit roughly in 18 minutes of prep, and the 17 cook minutes match the 12-minute simmer plus 5-minute rest, which suits a quick dinner.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm grain pot suits a mid-April evening, and 400g of browned mushrooms leads the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling one-pot meal of wholegrain, pulses, vegetables and cheese that a family would happily eat.
